what_they_do: Magenta builds AI agents that read and validate the documents regulated manufacturers (mainly aerospace and defense) have to produce and check before parts can ship, things like certificates of conformance, material certs, packing slips, purchase orders, and inspection reports. Today a quality or compliance person manually cross-references these documents against the purchase order and spec requirements, which takes 15 to 30 minutes per package and requires someone who knows standards like AS9100 well enough to catch a missing cert or a spec mismatch. Magenta's agents do that cross-referencing automatically and also extend into related paperwork-heavy tasks like invoice-to-PO matching, non-conformance report review, and work instruction generation.
vertical: Manufacturing compliance software (aerospace and defense document/quality workflows)
theme_fit_rationale: Magenta's entire wedge is ingesting unstructured documents (certs, packing slips, drawings, inspection reports) that legacy manufacturing software can't read, then using that as the entry point to automate a specific high-stakes workflow (supplier data package review, CoC generation), which is Theme 5 almost verbatim. It also fits Theme 2 secondarily since the roadmap extends into cross-functional workflows spanning quality, procurement (AP), and engineering across existing ERP/MES/PLM systems.
